name: libnyoci
description: libnyoci (darconeous/libnyoci, formerly SMCP): a full-stack RFC 7252 CoAP client/server library in C, with observe, async responses and block-wise transfer. Built from source via an overlay port since no official vcpkg registry port exists. SKELETON: an alternate CoAP backend to libcoap for kythira's coap_transport (include/raft/coap_transport_libnyoci_impl.hpp), gated behind the opt-in "coap-libnyoci" feature.
